# Client compatibility matrix

<!-- GENERATED by test/integration/compat.sh from run/compat/results-*.tsv. Do not edit. -->

Every client tool runs its operations twice, direct to the backend and through tollbooth, in front of each backend (test plan category 6). PASS: the operation succeeded through the proxy. FAIL: it succeeded direct and failed through the proxy, a transparency defect, with the last error line. GAP: it failed both ways identically, a backend limitation the proxy relayed faithfully, with the backend's words. Backends run as pinned static binaries (test/integration/backends.sh); tools are pinned in clients.sh.
